find_or_insert.comparator: memcmp over the common prefix; on a tie, the length difference saturated to int32: node longer by >= 2**31 stops the walk, node shorter by > 2**31 continues it, otherwise the low 32 bits decide (negative continues, non-negative stops); the second check applies the same comparison in the opposite direction, so the walk stops at the first node >= the key and reuses it exactly when the key is equal
find_or_insert.insert: 0x5153650 called with (target, stopped node, key pair at rsp+0x58); when the walk exhausts the list (stopped node == header pointer at target+0x08) the insert path is taken directly

capacity: temp = 0x4faf340(snapshot+0x00); 0x515f990 gives "capacity"; 0x5153a70(target, "capacity"); move-assign temp; dispose temp

secs_for_last_collection: window = 0x514df50(snapshot); negative results take the unsigned-conversion arm at 0x5158d53; value = (double)window / 1,000,000.0 (divsd by 0x20ae60); 0x514c050 formats it with "%f" into temp; 0x515fa60 gives the key; 0x5153a70; move-assign temp; dispose temp
